notes.title: Timerunner releases 29th November 2021, Add To Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35570939/5e485cef14d996c0a342a678ad14982c161dced8.jpg[/img]

Timerunner will release on 29th November 2021 and will be free for all current and future owners of Time To Stop Time until the release date.

If you don't have Time To Stop Time and want to get Timerunner separately, the game will be discounted on launch and will cost 5$.

Add to Wishlist and follow the game to get the latest updates!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108750/Timerunner/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108750/Timerunner/[/url]

notes.title: Introducing Timerunner! New Free Standalone Game For Owners of TTST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35570939/c72b04ef4dc62f3650d5ed79c85d5247165b6c07.jpg[/img]

Timerunner is a whole new standalone version of TTST reimagined and overhauled, the time stop mechanic is now reworked.

All owners of Time To Stop Time prior to Timerunner release will receive Timerunner for free!

Check the store page for Timerunner and follow the game to be notified when the game will be Available.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108750/Timerunner/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108750/Timerunner/
[/url]

What if you don't own TTST?

Timerunner will be as a standalone game for 8$
TTST base price will be reduced to 10$ (doesn't grant a free copy of Timerunner)

Timerunner + TTST bundle will be 15$

notes.title: Time To Stop Time Is Coming 6th November 2020
notes.content:
Time To Stop Time Is Coming 6th November 2020.

Use your time stopping powers to make the most out of what little time you have! 

The game will feature 40 Levels, with a wide ranges of weapons and abilities including; Rockets, Rifles, Lightsabers, Mechs, throwing roadrollers and more!

Priced at 15 USD or regional prices with a launch discount for the first week!
